Naunidhirāma
or Navanidhirāma, son of Harinārāyaṇa; grandson of Sukhalālāji, reader of Purāṇas to king Śārdūla.
--Garuḍapurāṇasārasaṅgraha an. C.
See Navanidhirāma; also NCC. V. p.. 324a-b.
Pt.. with Eng. transl. by Ernest Wood an. S. V. Subrahmanyam. Sacred Bk.. of the Hindus IX. Allahabad, 1911.
